verdict.rationale: The UK IPO is an online government service that collects applicant data through One Login and online filings, so asking how that data may be used, including for AI training, is a fair privacy question. Nothing in the evidence describes an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any user control over training. The robots.txt probe only shows the search host restricting automated agents; it says nothing about the user's own data or training use.
